- **Data Inseyets** — Based nearby in the broader Hunter region (Maitland/Newcastle corridor), they offer targeted [Data Consulting via Data Inseyets](https://datainseyets.com.au/) for small-to-mid enterprise clients looking for strategy development, dashboard creation, and automation solutions.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVhFNVpuSXdOekEwGAo)
